title: Home Economy
subtitle: Household finances, from your bank data
cardSourceTitle: Which card is this report from?
cardSourceFormats: Excel and CSV files downloaded from the issuer are supported.
cardSourceBankHint: Issued by the bank and settled as one monthly charge on the bank statement.
cardSourceExternalHint: Issued by a credit company and settled by its own direct debit.
recommendationsNeedData: Upload a bank report first to receive recommendations.
directoryIntro: Official comparison tools, support organizations and links to Israeli management companies.
directoryDisclaimer: This list is neither a ranking nor a recommendation. Compare returns, costs, risk and service using the official tools, and consider consulting a licensed professional. Support organizations set their own eligibility and service terms.
officialToolsNote: Services from the Capital Market Authority and Ministry of Finance.
gemelNetDescription: Compare returns and information for provident and study funds.
pensionNetDescription: Compare pension funds by returns, management fees and other data.
moneyMountainDescription: Find inactive pension accounts and savings at no cost.
authorityDescription: Public information, fee calculators and licensed-professional search.
independentAdvisorsNote: This is not a ranking or recommendation list. Search the official registry, verify an active licence, and separately check affiliations and compensation.
licensedPensionAdvisorsDescription: Search the Capital Market Authority registry by licence type, name and city. Select “pension adviser” and distinguish advisers from agents or marketers.
licensedInvestmentAdvisorsDescription: Use the Israel Securities Authority registry to check licence holders. Verify the licence type and status before engaging an adviser.
verifyIndependenceIntro: Ask for written answers before sharing information or paying.
verifyLicenseType: Verify an active licence of the type required for the requested service.
verifyCompensation: Ask who pays the adviser, which commissions they receive, and whether they have an affiliation with a product or financial institution.
verifyScope: Get the price, scope, deliverables and cancellation policy in writing beforehand.
doritGovAriDescription: An external professional profile for a financial planner. Inclusion is not a recommendation or verification of independence; check licensing, affiliations and compensation before engaging.
supportOrganizationsNote: Guidance, knowledge and practical tools delivered by professionals and volunteers.
paamonimDescription: Household financial guidance and counseling delivered by professionals and volunteers.
mekimiDescription: A nonprofit providing counseling, guidance and assistance to families facing financial and family hardship.
paamonimWhatsAppDescription: Updates and useful Paamonim content about household financial management.
communityNote: Two communities, the same content. Choose the privacy trade-off that suits you — each gives up something different.
communityDisclaimer: The communities are hosted on an outside service, so the promise that your data stays on your device does not extend to them. Anything you write there is visible to members and stored by that service — never share bank statements, account numbers or identifying details.
communityWhatsAppDescription: Message content is end-to-end encrypted, but joining requires a phone number — and it is visible to the other members.
communityTelegramDescription: You can take part under a username alone and keep your phone number hidden, but group messages are stored on Telegram servers and are not end-to-end encrypted.
companiesNote: Links to official websites, without ranking or preference.
incomeVsExpensesChart: Money in versus money out, month by month
privacyFooter: Minimised transactions, categories, rules and budgets are stored only in this browser and are never sent to a server. Account and card numbers, CVV, references and file names are not stored. The browser also keeps how you reached the site (utm parameters and gclid) and your last 50 usage events; these are not sent anywhere either. Fonts are served from this site, so no third-party request is made. Any future cloud sync will be optional, and only after signing in and giving explicit consent.
monthlyBudgetLimitsNote: Leave a limit empty to exclude it from tracking. The limit is compared with spending in the selected month.
automaticRulesNote: Each transaction uses the first rule that matches its description. A category selected manually in the transaction table takes precedence.
categoriesNote: The first eight categories have dedicated chart colors; additional categories are shown in gray.
cloudConsentIntro: Cloud sync is not active yet. This approval records your choice only and uploads nothing.
cloudConsentData: If enabled later, minimised transactions, categories, rules and budgets will be stored in your secured account for backup and recovery. Account and card numbers, CVV, references and filenames will be excluded.
cloudConsentVoluntary: The choice is voluntary. You can keep using the app locally without consenting and withdraw consent at any time.
cloudConsentAdvice: Forecasts and findings may be wrong and are not financial, pension, tax or legal advice. Verify information before acting.
cloudConsentRights: This approval does not waive rights that cannot legally be waived.
cloudConsentCheckbox: I have read and understood this notice and voluntarily agree to the described terms for future cloud sync.
cloudConsentNotAccepted: Cloud-sync consent has not been given.
cloudConsentAcceptedAt: Consent was recorded on this device on {date}. No data has been uploaded.
cloudConsentSavedLocally: Consent was recorded on this device only
addManualTransactionNote: Add cash, a charge not yet shown in a report, or a quick correction. The transaction is stored locally.
storageSaveError: Browser storage is unavailable; data will be kept only until this tab is closed
dataLooksBalanced: The imported data currently looks balanced
recNegativeImpact: Impact: avoid interest, returned payments and delayed charges.

recBudgetExceededImpact: Impact: return {amount} to the monthly budget.

recClassifyDetail: {count} transactions in the selected month are categorized as Other.
recClassifyImpact: Impact: more accurate budgets and forecasts.
recReviewRecurringDetail: {merchant} recurs at a typical amount of {amount}.

recContinueDetail: There is currently no overrun or risk requiring immediate action.
recContinueImpact: Impact: maintain control of cash flow and spending.
unaccountedTransfers: Plus {amount} in transfers excluded from the total
oneMonthHistory: One month in history—load more reports to see a trend
forecastNoBalance: The imported reports contain no balance, so a forecast cannot be calculated.
forecastBaseWithDaily: The balance continues from {balance} on {date}, less estimated daily spending of {daily}.
forecastBaseWithoutDaily: The balance continues from {balance} on {date}, with no ongoing daily spending beyond recurring charges.
forecastRecurringSuffix: {count} recurring charges are added on their expected dates.

forecastThinHistory: Only {days} days of history are available; the forecast will improve as more reports are loaded.

budgetsNotConfiguredNote: No limits have been set yet. Set a monthly category limit to see how much remains.
budgetTrackingSummary: {spent} of {cap} used in tracked categories in {month}.
noExpensesThisMonth: There are no expenses this month.
categorySpendingSummary: {total} in expenses in {month}. The largest category is {category}, at {percent}% of total spending.
recurringNoneNote: A charge is considered recurring when the same merchant appears in at least two months. None have been found yet—load more reports.
recurringSummary: {count} recurring merchants: {out} out and {in} in during a typical month. These totals include regular transfers and feed the forecast.
categoryUpdatedToast: The category was updated for this transaction only. Add a rule in Settings for permanent categorization.
showingFirstTransactions: Showing {shown} of {total} transactions—narrow the results with search
storedDataSummary: {transactions} stored transactions, {months} months and {overrides} manual assignments. {range}
noStoredData: No data has been stored yet.
backupCopied: File saving is unavailable here—the backup was copied to the clipboard
backupExportUnavailable: A backup cannot be exported in this view
invalidBackup: This file is not a valid Home Economy backup
fileUnreadable: We could not open {file}. Try exporting it again from the card issuer as Excel or CSV.
fileColumnsUnrecognized: No statement columns were recognised in {file}. Columns found: {columns}
noTransactionsInFile: No transactions were found in the file
importStep1: In your bank: Checking account → Transactions → Export to Excel.
importStep2: Drop the file here. Old and new Excel exports and CSV files are supported.
importStep3: Each additional report extends your history. Previously imported transactions are not counted twice.
emptyTitle: See where the money goes. Know what to do next.
emptyText: Load a bank report and get a private snapshot, budgets, forecast and action recommendations in your browser—without signing up or sending data to a server.
benefitClarityText: Income, expenses, balance and monthly trend in one place.
benefitActionText: Spot budget overruns, recurring charges and cash-flow risks that need attention.
benefitPrivacyText: Files are read locally and are never uploaded or shared.
howTitle: From bank report to action plan
finalCtaText: Start with one report. No registration or account connection required.
dropHint: Or choose Upload bank report or Upload card report above
spendingGuideTitle: Safe to spend until the next income
spendingGuideUntil: For the {days} days until expected income on {date}
spendingGuideAsOf: Based on the balance in your latest report, as of {date}.
spendingGuideUntilTight: For the {days} days until income expected on {date}. The balance, not your spending rate, is the limit here.
spendingGuideNoBalance: A current balance is needed to calculate this amount.
spendingGuideNoIncome: No regular income has been detected yet; the amount is shown without a time allowance.
spendingGuideGap: Expected commitments exceed the balance by {amount} before {date}. Review your cash flow.
transactionTableScrollHint: Swipe horizontally to see all columns.
agentsIntro: Each agent checks a different pattern locally. Nothing is changed without your approval.
agentNoLearning: After you categorize two similar transactions alike, I can suggest a rule.
agentLearningProposal: I found the pattern “{match}” in transactions you assigned to {category}. Use it as a rule from now on?
agentNoAnomalies: No unusual increase was found against each recurring charge's own history.
agentAnomalyResult: {merchant}: the latest charge is {latest}, {percent}% above its usual {baseline}.
agentNoMissing: No overdue recurring charge or credit was found.
agentMissingIncomeResult: {merchant}: expected income of about {amount} around day {day} has not appeared.
agentMissingExpenseResult: {merchant}: an expected charge of about {amount} around day {day} has not appeared.
agentNoDuplicates: No similar charges from the same merchant were found a few days apart.
agentNoSubscriptions: There is not enough history yet to identify monthly subscriptions.
agentSubscriptionResult: {merchant}: about {monthly} per month, or {annual} per year.
agentNoBudgetSuggestions: More spending history is needed to suggest budget limits.
agentBudgetResult: Suggested limit for {category}: {amount}, based on the 75th percentile of the last {months} months.
agentNoSavingsOpportunities: There is not enough history yet to identify a measurable saving opportunity.
agentSavingsSummaryAnnual: Found {count} opportunities to review, with potential savings of up to {annual} per year.
agentSavingsSummaryOneTime: Found {count} opportunities to review, with one-time potential of up to {oneTime}.
agentSavingsSummaryCombined: Found {count} opportunities to review: up to {annual} per year plus {oneTime} one time.
agentSavingsSubscription: {merchant}: review whether this recurring subscription is still needed; {amount} per year is available for review.
agentSavingsPriceIncrease: {merchant}: the price increased by {percent}%. Returning to the previous price could save {amount} per year.
agentSavingsFee: {merchant}: review or negotiate this recurring fee, worth up to {amount} per year.
agentSavingsDuplicate: {merchant}: review a possible duplicate charge of {amount}.
agentSavingsDisclaimer: This is an estimate to review, not a promise of savings. Verify with the provider before cancelling a service or charge.
agentPaydayNoBalance: A current balance is needed to calculate what remains.
agentPaydayNoIncome: No regular monthly income was detected. The current balance is {balance}.
agentPaydayResult: From a balance of {balance}, {committed} is expected before {date}. {free} remains for flexible spending.
